theseSettingsApplyOnlyTo: These settings apply only to Yi Console on this device. Host-specific settings (tool paths, relay pairing, status line) are under each host's Settings in the sidebar.
chooseTheDisplayLanguageFor: Choose the display language for the interface
whenSetToSystemAutomatically: When set to System, automatically follows OS dark/light mode
minimalGroupsConsecutiveThinkingAnd: Minimal: Groups consecutive thinking and tool calls into a compact summary
claudeCodeDotTimelineOn: Claude Code: Dot timeline on the left with each tool call and summary on its own line
messagesLoadedWhenOpeningA: Messages Loaded When Opening a Session
loadThisManyRecentRecords: Load this many recent records (including tool calls) first; scroll up to load earlier ones. Lower it if remote hosts feel slow.
groupedByWorkingDirectoryMost: Grouped by working directory, most recent first
oneListSortedByRecent: One list sorted by recent activity, each row shows its directory
endedSessionsIdleThisLong: Ended sessions idle this long are folded behind "Show more" at the end of each directory. Pinned sessions and search results are never folded.
colorSchemeAndFontSize: Color scheme and font size for terminal sessions (themes from Windows Terminal). You can also toggle them from the terminal status bar.
notificationsAreNotAllowedFor: Notifications are not allowed for Yi Console. Please enable them in system settings.
claudeCodeReplyFinishedTest: Claude Code reply finished: Test notification
thisIsATestNotification: This is a test notification. System notifications are working properly.
showSystemNotificationsWhenAi: Show system notifications when AI finishes replying or awaits approval
includeTheBeginningOfThe: Include the beginning of the reply in the notification
whenAToolNeedsYour: When a tool needs your confirmation to run commands or edit files
notificationsDeniedEnableYiConsole: Notifications denied: Enable Yi Console in Windows (Settings → System → Notifications) or macOS (System Settings → Notifications)
systemNotificationsAreNotSupported: System notifications are not supported in this environment
systemWillPromptForPermission: System will prompt for permission on first notification
notificationSoundFollowsOsSettings: Notification sound follows OS settings. "When away from session" includes when the window is minimized, unfocused, or viewing another session. Mobile app cannot receive notifications while in background.
webVersionRequiresTheTab: Web version requires the tab to stay open.
proxySettingsSavedAppliesTo: Proxy settings saved (applies to new connections)
usedWhenConnectingToSsh: Used when connecting to SSH hosts and relays. Auto mode reads HTTPS_PROXY / HTTP_PROXY / ALL_PROXY env vars or system proxy; private IPs and NO_PROXY hosts connect directly. HTTP proxy only.
chatFontSizeDesc: Text size of AI replies, your messages and the input box; code blocks follow it
editorFontSizeDesc: Text size of the workspace file editor, diffs and Markdown preview
uiZoomDesc: Zoom the whole interface in or out; shortcuts {{mod}} + = / {{mod}} + - / {{mod}} + 0 (reset)
